summary_en: Introduces DP-PINN, a single-sample physics-informed method for nearfield acoustic holography that parameterizes source-surface velocity with an MLP and enforces propagation consistency through the Rayleigh integral. A deep-image-prior regularizer and SNR-linked stochastic perturbation improve low-SNR robustness; simulations and anechoic experiments show substantially lower reconstruction error than equivalent-source and purely data-driven baselines.

summary_en: Presents E2E-HPC, an end-to-end heterogeneous-physics-constrained framework that directly optimizes the physical thickness structure of passive acoustic holograms. Differentiable surrogate and propagation models capture internal volumetric coupling and heterogeneous-media distortion, reducing the design-to-reality gap and enabling high-fidelity multi-plane focusing plus frequency-controlled pattern switching.

summary_en: Develops a transcranial ultrasound sound-speed reconstruction pipeline combining a high-fidelity full-wave simulator with WAM-Net, which uses wavefront attention and gradient regularization to recover heterogeneous skull acoustic properties from plane-wave RF data. The method improves reconstruction error over prior learning baselines and is validated on skull phantoms and in-vivo macaque data, supporting rapid phase-aberration correction for transcranial imaging.
